en: Claude extra usage is now informational rather than an execution blocker. Prism no longer refuses a Claude task because extra usage is enabled or stops an ongoing task when the CLI reports overage.

Claude account and organization settings govern extra usage, which may consume team credits or incur additional charges. Subscription authentication, API-key isolation and Grok billing guards remain in place. The allowance panel explains the Claude behavior.
zh: Claude 额外用量改为状态提示：不再因开关开启而拒绝执行，也不再因 CLI 报告额外用量而强行停止任务。
Claude 额外用量由账号及团队设置管理，可能消耗团队余额或产生额外费用。保留订阅登录校验、API Key 隔离和 Grok 计费保护，并更新额度面板说明。
